d:
A little mischief, a lot of fun, and a whole lot of love! Relive the playful chemistry of Aamir Khan & Kareena Kapoor with Zoobi Doobi from 3 Idiots, now in stunning 8K clarity!
Song: Zoobi Doobi
Singers: Sonu Nigam & Shreya Ghoshal
Lyricist: Swanand Kirkire
Music Composer: Shantanu Moitra
Starring: Aamir Khan, R. Madhavan, Sharman Joshi, Kareena Kapoor &
Boman Irani
Directed by Rajkumar Hirani
